issues.where: inside the upper half of the glass, hanging from the ring at its top (set-F-02 crops 1, 4; set-F-03 crop 7)
issues.what: six or seven thin dark, curling lines run down from the top of the glass, each ending in a bead. At normal size they look like wires or hairs inside the globe, not condensation runs. The ring at the top looks like a stopper cap sitting on the sphere
issues.fix: remove the lines. If you want condensation runs, make them short, straight, clear refractive streaks on the outside of the glass, running downward and fading out, with no dark core. Remove the ring at the apex

issues.where: out-of-focus petals in the right foreground and in the reflection (set-E-03 crops 8, 12; set-E-02 crop 6)
issues.what: when they blur, the petals become translucent rectangles and squares. The petal is a flat textured card and its alpha edges show through the depth of field. This is easy to see in the still
issues.fix: use real petal geometry, or cut-out cards with premultiplied alpha that defocus correctly, so a blurred petal keeps its own outline

issues.where: the glass outline at shoulder and rim (set-F-02 crops 1, 2; set-F-03 crop 7); also set-D-02 crop 1
issues.what: the outer edge of the sphere is stair-stepped and serrated, with a light fringe. The rim band is a flat, even pale-grey stroke. It shows no rise and fall in thickness and no change in Fresnel brightness, so it reads as a plastic ring
issues.fix: render the silhouette with proper antialiasing. Give the rim a thickness that changes around it, with a thin bright edge and a darker band just inside where the light is refracted

issues.where: the glass interior near the rim and the space above the cottage (set-F-02 crops 2, 3)
issues.what: nothing seen through the sphere is bent or enlarged. The background lights do not appear inverted in the glass, the cottage and ground near the rim are not squeezed, and the upper interior is a flat grey haze
issues.fix: use a thick, solid-filled refractive sphere with water IOR so the inside is magnified and pinched at the edges and the background lights show up small and inverted

issues.where: the collar where the sphere meets the moss (set-F-03 crops 9, 10, 12; set-D-01 top edge)
issues.what: the glass stops on a hard curved line straight onto the moss. There is no collar or seat, no contact shadow and no caustic
issues.fix: add a ring for the sphere to sit in: a collar of stone, root or metal. Put a thin dark contact line under the glass and a soft light caustic on the moss

issues.where: the ground disc inside the globe, below the pond (set-F-02 crops 3, 5; set-D-02 crops 2, 3)
issues.what: the miniature's ground ends in a vertical band of flat green, like a cake slice. In set-D the band has a regular woven grid texture. It looks like fabric, not soil or turf
issues.fix: replace the band with a soil and turf section that has roots, stones and uneven relief, or curve the ground down to meet the glass so no side band shows. Remove the tiled weave

issues.what: the crown is a single cluster of flat pink cut-out cards. The colour is the same all through, the inside has no darker shadow, the gaps have no depth and the outline is ragged like a stencil
issues.fix: build the crown from branch structure with separate blossom clusters. Add self-shadowing and translucency, darker inside and lit at the rim

issues.where: the cottage wall and roof (set-F-02 crops 3, 6)
issues.what: the wall uses a flat stone texture with no relief and the roof is one flat plane with no shingle edges. It reads as a low-detail model
issues.fix: displace the stones and mortar, add separate shingle rows with a lip at the eave, and add grime and moss at the base of the wall

issues.where: the moss on top of the base (set-D-02 crops 2, 3, 4; set-D-03 crop 8)
issues.what: the moss has a procedural cell pattern with visible polygon or Voronoi seams. It is also covered with even bright yellow-green dot speckle that reads as noise, not as fronds
issues.fix: use moss with clumps and strands of varied height and remove the cell seams. Replace the speckle with sparse dew catching the light at different sizes

issues.where: the waterfall down the left of the base (set-D-02 crops 1, 5; set-F-03 crops 8, 11)
issues.what: the water is one smooth, glossy ribbon like clear plastic. It has no white water, no spray, no break into streams, and the stone around it is not wet or darker
issues.fix: break the flow into streams with aerated white edges and spray at the foot. Darken the stone and add a wet sheen around it

issues.where: the roots and mushrooms over the base (set-D-02 crop 6; set-D-03 crops 7, 10)
issues.what: the roots are even, smooth tubes with the same bark texture everywhere. Where they meet they leave a dark triangular hole (crop 7). The mushrooms have smooth plastic caps with no gills and no change in surface
issues.fix: taper the roots and give them knots and bark relief. Fix the geometry at the junction. Add gills, cap mottling and a soft subsurface look to the mushrooms

issues.where: the petals resting on the water at the base's foot (set-D-03 crops 9, 10, 12)
issues.what: the petals are sharp, flat and all one colour. They cast no reflection or contact shadow on the water and make no meniscus, though the base reflects clearly. They look pasted on
issues.fix: lay the petals into the water surface with a faint reflection, a contact darkening and a slight lift at the edges

issues.where: the petals scattered across the surface, left and right (set-F-03 crops 11, 12; set-E-02 crops 1, 4, 5)
issues.what: every petal is the same size, shape and salmon colour, flat, at the same tilt and spread at an even density, so they read as a particle scatter
issues.fix: vary size, colour from pale to deep pink, curl and wilting. Cluster them in drifts against the base and along water lines, with some overlapping and some wet and translucent

issues.where: the dark water surface (set-D-03 crops 9, 12; set-E-02 crop 5)
issues.what: small sharp cyan-white dots of the same size are scattered evenly across the water and none of them are out of focus
issues.fix: remove them, or make them sparse glints that follow the depth of field

issues.where: petals in the air beside the base at right (set-D-03 crop 8)
issues.what: several petals hang right against the side of the base with no motion blur, so they look frozen or stuck to it
issues.fix: add motion blur and space them away from the base, or move them to rest on the surface
